summary_bullets: Guard grouped reuse copy, sidecar, and ledger writes so reuse failures return non-zero with cleanup
Fall through to the existing phase-2 relaunch path when grouped reuse cannot copy a prior result
Prefer the most recent grouped ok ledger row and cover stale-copy recovery with a regression test
commit_message:
Handle grouped reuse copy failures

Fall back to phase-2 relaunch when grouped dedup reuse cannot write its copied result, and prefer the latest ok ledger row for later reuse.
